fields.name: page-type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The Site Global Template of the page (layout and template code). Overrides the page-type column of the metadata sheet.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: The header (nav) page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Navigation (or the metadata sheet's nav column), else the locale's references/nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: The footer page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Footer (or the metadata sheet's footer column), else the locale's references/footer.

fields.name: error-page
fields.label: 404 Page
fields.description: The page shown when a page below this one isn't found. Empty: the nearest parent page's 404 Page (or the metadata sheet's error-page column), else the locale's error-pages/404.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers. Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: anchorName
fields.label: Anchor name
fields.description: Lets Anchor List links jump to this section, e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces).

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link Title
fields.description: e.g. CH 1: Overview

fields.name: anchorName
fields.label: Anchor Name
fields.description: The Anchor name of the target section (Section properties), e.g. overview. Heading ids work too.

fields.name: sticky
fields.label: Sticky
fields.description: Keep the links at the top of the screen while scrolling.

fields.name: searchAudioIconAlt
fields.label: Search bar audio icon alt text

fields.name: searchButtonLabel
fields.label: Search bar button icon type hover text

fields.name: conversationCanvas
fields.label: Conversation Canvas Page
fields.description: A page with the conversation-canvas block (e.g. references/conversation-canvas), shown above the copyright and links

fields.name: copyright
fields.label: Copyright Text
fields.description: e.g. ©TATA Consultancy Services {year}; {year} is replaced with the current year

fields.name: name
fields.label: Field Name / ID
fields.description: Submitted as the field key, e.g. firstName. Names containing "name" sit side by side on desktop.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Field Label
fields.description: e.g. First name

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.label: Show only if dropdown value equals
fields.description: Leave empty to always show the field.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Dropdown Name / ID
fields.description: Submitted as the field key, e.g. sector or region.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Dropdown Label
fields.description: e.g. Sector

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Comma separated, e.g. Technology, Sport, Asia Pacific, India

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.label: Show only if dropdown value equals
fields.description: Leave empty to always show the field.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Field Name / ID
fields.description: Submitted as the field key, e.g. feedback.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Field Label
fields.description: e.g. How can we help you?

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.label: Show only if dropdown value equals
fields.description: Leave empty to always show the field.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Checkbox Name / ID
fields.description: Submitted as the field key, e.g. consent.

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.label: Show only if dropdown value equals
fields.description: Leave empty to always show the field.

fields.name: region
fields.label: Show when dropdown value equals
fields.description: e.g. India

fields.name: contactName
fields.label: Contact Name
fields.description: e.g. Iris Tham

fields.name: emails
fields.label: Emails
fields.description: Comma separated

fields.name: phones
fields.label: Phones
fields.description: Comma separated

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.label: Show only if dropdown value equals
fields.description: Leave empty to always show the button.

fields.name: carouselNavigation
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: Manual: previous / next buttons, dots and swipe. Auto: slides advance on their own, with a pause button. Manual and Auto: both.

fields.name: carouselInterval
fields.label: Autoplay interval (seconds)
fields.description: Time each slide is shown before the next one appears.

fields.name: content_iconAlt
fields.label: Icon Image Alt Text
fields.description: Leave empty if the icon is decorative.

fields.name: classes_media
fields.label: Hero Image type
fields.description: Default: the Hero Image Path is an image. Lotto: it is a Lottie animation file (.json), played as the hero background.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Hero Image Path
fields.description: Default: an image. Lotto: a Lottie animation file (.json).

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Hero Image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image or animation is decorative.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Hero View
fields.description: Default: the image fills the hero behind the content. Contained image: the image (e.g. an illustration) is shown whole, centered behind the content.

fields.name: content_titleType
fields.label: Title heading level
fields.description: Use H1 for the first hero of a page, H2 for the others.

fields.name: ctaArrow
fields.label: CTA Arrow
fields.description: Direction of the arrow next to the CTA text.

fields.name: classes_motion
fields.label: Motion Type
fields.description: Animates the hero when it comes into view (not when reduced motion is preferred).

fields.name: classes_alignment
fields.label: Vertical Alignment
fields.description: Position of the content block: top, middle or bottom of the hero.

fields.name: classes_horizontal
fields.label: Horizontal Alignment
fields.description: Position of the content block: left, center or right of the hero (on desktop).

fields.name: classes_textAlignment
fields.label: Text Alignment
fields.description: Alignment of the icon, text and CTAs inside the content block.

fields.name: classes_background
fields.label: BG Color
fields.description: Default: light, the image under a white overlay. Light, no overlay: the image as is (e.g. a light gradient) with dark text. The dark options put white text over a navy or black overlay.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Modal Content
fields.description: A fragment page, e.g. under /modals/. Opens in a dialog.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: The content comes from the page's metadata (title, description, tags, content type, publish date, reading time, author, featured image, listen link). Default: Landing for the landing and listing page types, else Article.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Quote Author
fields.description: Name on the first line, then designation and organisation.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt Text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: imagePosition
fields.label: Image Position (Desktop)
fields.description: Side of the image on desktop (900px and wider); the quote overlaps it.

fields.name: imagePositionMobile
fields.label: Image Position (Mobile)
fields.description: Image above or below the quote on mobile and tablet (narrower than 900px).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The label of the tab. The components after this Tab, up to the next Tab, are its content.

fields.name: tabId
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Links to #ID open this tab (deep link), e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces). Leave empty for an id from the Tabs ID.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.label: Active tab
fields.description: Shows this tab when the page loads (the first tab if no tab is active).

fields.name: variations
fields.label: Variation
fields.description: Variation 1: title, description and arrow. Variation 2: description, large title and button. Variation 3: description, number, large title and arrow.

options.name: Variation 3 - Description, number, large title, arrow

fields.name: maxCards
fields.label: Maximum items
fields.description: Display between 1 and 10 items.

validation.customErrorMsg: Maximum items must be between 1 and 10.

fields.name: viewAllLabel
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Text of the link next to the heading, e.g. Industries or All Products & Platforms.

fields.name: viewAllLink
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Destination of the link next to the heading. The link is shown only when set.

fields.name: ctaStyle
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Variation default: filled button (Variation 1), outline button (Variation 2), text link (Variation 3).

fields.name: numbers
fields.label: Numbers
fields.description: Variation default: on mobile only (Variation 1), hidden (Variation 2), shown (Variation 3). Items are numbered 01, 02, ... unless an item has its own Number.

fields.name: itemAction
fields.label: Item link
fields.description: Variation default: arrow (Variation 1), button (Variation 2), diagonal arrow (Variation 3).

fields.name: itemButtonLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Text of the item buttons; an item can have its own.

fields.name: motion
fields.label: Motion Type
fields.description: Animates the items as they scroll into view (not when reduced motion is preferred).

fields.name: exploreLink
fields.label: Explore All Link
fields.description: Legacy header link. The parent View All settings take precedence when configured.

fields.name: number
fields.label: Number
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to number items automatically (01, 02, ...).

fields.name: trademark
fields.label: Trademark
fields.description: A trademark sign after the title, e.g. TwinX™.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.value: Risk free business experimentation and decision intelligence

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Destination page of the item.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Optional. Overrides the block Button text for this item (button item links only).

fields.name: anchorName
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Unique id of the Tabs, e.g. our-services (lowercase, no spaces). Tabs without an ID of their own get ids from it: our-services-item-1, ... Leave empty for a generated id.

fields.name: tabsAriaLabel
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Names the tab list for screen readers (aria-label), e.g. Our services.

fields.name: tabsOrientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.description: Vertical: the tab list is on the left of the content on desktop, above it on mobile.

fields.name: tabsId
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Unique id of the Tabs, e.g. our-services (lowercase, no spaces). Tabs without an ID of their own get ids from it: our-services-item-1, ... Leave empty for a generated id.

fields.name: tabsAriaLabel
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Names the tab list for screen readers (aria-label), e.g. Our services.

fields.name: tabsOrientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.description: Vertical: the tab list is on the left of the content on desktop, above it on mobile.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The label of the tab.

fields.name: tabId
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Links to #ID open this tab (deep link), e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces). Leave empty for an id from the Tabs ID.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.label: Active tab
fields.description: Shows this tab when the page loads (the first tab if no tab is active).

fields.name: fragment
fields.label: Fragment
fields.description: A page whose content (any components, e.g. Columns, Title, Text, Image, Button) is shown in the tab.

fields.name: titleHidden
fields.label: Hide Title
fields.description: The title stays available to screen readers.

fields.name: shortDescription
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: Shown after the links.

fields.name: dateLabel
fields.label: Date label
fields.description: Shown before the date, e.g. Published.

fields.name: readingTime
fields.label: Reading time
fields.description: Minutes (e.g. 14, shown as "14 min read") or any text.

fields.name: listenLink
fields.label: Listen link
fields.description: An audio version of the page: shows the listen icon.

fields.name: download
fields.label: Download
fields.description: Shows the download icon (prints the page or saves it as PDF).

fields.name: socialShare
fields.label: Share
fields.description: Shows the share icon (share dialog, or the link copied).

fields.name: authorDesignation
fields.label: Author designation
fields.description: e.g. TCS Role.

fields.name: authorImageAlt
fields.label: Author image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: imageFormat
fields.label: Image type
fields.description: Default: the Image is a picture. Lotto: the Image is a Lottie animation file (.json).

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Image & Text: beside the text. Text split: in the text column (e.g. a chart). Background image and Card: behind the text.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: imagePositionMobile
fields.label: Image position (mobile)
fields.description: Image above or below the text on mobile (narrower than 900px). Default: above, or in the text order for Text split.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Image & Text: image and text side by side. Text split: title left, text, links and stats right. Background image: the image behind centered text. Card: a rounded card with the image behind its text.

fields.name: textAlignment
fields.label: Text alignment
fields.description: Layout default: left, centered for Background image and when Image & Text has no image.

fields.name: verticalAlignment
fields.label: Vertical alignment
fields.description: How the text and the image (or the two text columns) line up. Layout default: center, top for Text split.

fields.name: topSpacing
fields.label: Top spacing
fields.description: Page header: the larger space above a teaser that opens a page.

fields.name: multiLinks
fields.label: Multiple links
fields.description: On: a list of links. Off: a primary and a secondary button.

fields.name: linkArrow
fields.label: List arrow
fields.description: Arrow of the List link style.

fields.name: statValue
fields.label: Stats Value
fields.description: A single line, e.g. 40%.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: The testimonial quote.

fields.name: authorName
fields.label: Author
fields.description: e.g. Ranil Boteju, Chief Data & Analytics Officer, Lloyds Banking Group

fields.name: authorImageAlt
fields.label: Author Image Alt Text
fields.description: Leave empty if the name is next to the image.

fields.name: designationLocation
fields.label: Designation & Location
fields.description: e.g. name, designation, organisation.

fields.name: titleHidden
fields.label: Hide Title
fields.description: The title stays available to screen readers.

fields.name: hideAuthor
fields.label: Hide Author Details
fields.description: Hides the author, author image and designation & location

fields.name: statValue
fields.label: Stats Value
fields.description: A single line, e.g. 40%.

fields.name: uri
fields.label: Video
fields.description: A video file from AEM Assets (MP4, WebM), or a YouTube or Vimeo link

fields.name: label
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Names the video for screen readers (e.g. "TCS AI lab tour"); not shown on the page

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Shown below the video

fields.name: transcript
fields.label: Transcript
fields.description: A page or document with the transcript; shown as a link below the video

fields.name: placeholder_image
fields.label: Poster Image
fields.description: Shown before the video plays, with a play button

options.name: Background video (autoplay, muted, loop, no controls)

fields.name: muted
fields.label: Muted
fields.description: Start without sound (always on for autoplay and background videos)

fields.name: controls
fields.label: Show Player Controls
fields.description: Background videos never show controls

fields.name: startTime
fields.label: Start At (seconds)
fields.description: Optional, e.g. 30

fields.name: endTime
fields.label: End At (seconds)
fields.description: Optional

fields.name: openInModal
fields.label: Play in a Pop-up
fields.description: The play button opens the video in a dialog over the page

fields.name: pauseOffscreen
fields.label: Pause When Out of View
fields.description: Autoplay and background video files pause when scrolled away and resume when back

fields.name: captions
fields.label: Captions File (WebVTT)
fields.description: Subtitles for video files (.vtt); YouTube and Vimeo use the captions added there

fields.name: captionsLanguage
fields.label: Captions Language
fields.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, ja (default: the page language)

fields.name: captionsLabel
fields.label: Captions Name
fields.description: Shown in the player's captions menu, e.g. English

fields.name: alignment
fields.label: Alignment
fields.description: For sizes other than full width

fields.name: privacyMode
fields.label: Privacy-enhanced Mode
fields.description: YouTube: no cookies until the video plays (youtube-nocookie.com); Vimeo: do not track
